authority.route: normal controls and anomaly proxies rendered by one OS1-128 first-return approximation, frozen STU, four-level time-stratified point model

task.name: AJAE
task.window_output: one anomaly logit for every visible return in every input frame
task.sequence_output: one equal mean of window probabilities for every canonical frame-ray return

development.exclusion_reason: verified exact internal duplication in scans and labels

binary_anomaly.raw_semantic_0: ignore unless replaced by a valid inserted return

labels.zero_coordinate_slot: not a visible return unless rendering creates a valid inserted return

stu.normal_evidence_rule: select minimum-index argmax_q sigmoid(mask[v,q])*max_c<19 softmax(logits[q])[c], then use sigmoid(mask[v,q*])*softmax(logits[q*])[:19]

render.name: rigid-single-frame OS1-128 first-return counterfactual approximation

azimuth_continuity_definition.eligible_edge: both (b,a) and (b,(a+1) mod 1024) contain real XYZ returns; never bridge empty columns
azimuth_continuity_definition.unobserved_wraparound_rule: if column 1023 or 0 is always empty across all audit frames, classify as unidentifiable_from_observed_returns
azimuth_continuity_definition.frozen_conclusion: All observable azimuth-adjacent edges are continuous; wraparound is directly evidenced for 120/128 rows and unidentifiable from observed returns for 8/128 rows in train/206.

phase_aligned_cross_frame_direction_stab.historical_fixed_slot_result: E11-v1 FAIL; a fixed file slot is not a stable physical ray and must not be reused as rho_f
phase_aligned_cross_frame_direction_stab.beam_identity: inherit the deterministic ordered 128-row identity from E09-v2
phase_aligned_cross_frame_direction_stab.mapping_family: one integer cyclic column shift per frame and beam; no pointwise nearest-neighbour assignment, non-cyclic permutation, duplicate, or fabricated return
phase_aligned_cross_frame_direction_stab.mapping_estimator: deterministic alternating maximization of observed unit-direction agreement with one fixed canonical direction template; equal-weight template update and exhaustive 1024-shift row update
phase_aligned_cross_frame_direction_stab.mapping_gauge: for every beam, anchor the frame-0 cyclic shift to zero by an equivalent canonical-template roll
phase_aligned_cross_frame_direction_stab.initial_template: equal-weight normalized mean by raw row/column slot; raw slots never observed in train/206 use deterministic same-beam periodic interpolation only for the direction template, never as a return; the template is re-estimated after every mapping update
phase_aligned_cross_frame_direction_stab.empty_slot_rule: all 128x1024 canonical rays and raw slots remain in rho_f; an empty mapped ray has no return and normal range +infinity
phase_aligned_cross_frame_direction_stab.round_trip: raw slot -> (b,a) -> rho_f(b,a) -> raw slot must be exact for every slot in every frame; valid-return count and raw XYZI/XYZ/range must be exactly recoverable

coordinate_source_diagnostic.question: Determine whether released STU .bin XYZ is raw lidar/sensor-frame Cartesian output, a whole-frame rigid transform, per-column or per-point motion-compensated output, or unresolved from released evidence.
required_evidence: official STU paper and supplementary material
official STU repository including full history
released file inventory for timestamps, packets, bags, and Ouster metadata
official Ouster Cartesian projection and motion-compensation definitions
coordinate_source_diagnostic.ouster_geometry_check: distinguish physical beam direction from normalized Cartesian XYZ because Ouster XYZLut uses range-scaled direction plus a beam-origin-dependent offset
coordinate_source_diagnostic.whole_frame_test_unlock_rule: E11-D2 is eligible only if a concrete whole-frame transform applied to released XYZ is identified and invertible from released calibration or poses.
coordinate_source_diagnostic.deskew_test_unlock_rule: E11-D3 is eligible only if per-point/per-column timestamps plus the applied deskew trajectory/model, or original Ouster packet metadata sufficient to reconstruct them, are available.
forbidden_followups: free ray mapping fitted to E11 residuals

row_layout_phase_diagnostic.question: Determine whether train/206 has a deterministic fixed per-beam column-phase structure consistent with common-azimuth columns or with an Ouster-like row shift, without naming the shift as factory pixel_shift_by_row.
row_layout_phase_diagnostic.nominal_column_angle: theta_a = -2*pi*a/1024, inheriting the E10-v3 scan orientation
row_layout_phase_diagnostic.frame_beam_phase: equal-weight circular mean of atan2(y,x)-theta_a over real returns only
row_layout_phase_diagnostic.frame_common_phase: equal-weight circular mean of all 128 finite frame-beam phases
row_layout_phase_diagnostic.fixed_beam_phase: equal-weight circular mean of the 449 relative phases for each beam
row_layout_phase_diagnostic.integer_shift: nearest integer of fixed_beam_phase/(360/1024), represented relative to the circular row consensus; ties choose the smaller integer
row_layout_phase_diagnostic.common_azimuth_column_rule: stability passes and max_b(abs(wrap(fixed_beam_phase_b))) < 0.17578125 deg after the per-frame common-phase gauge
row_layout_phase_diagnostic.stable_nonconstant_row_phase_rule: stability passes, the common-azimuth-column rule fails, and integer_shift is nonconstant across beams
row_layout_phase_diagnostic.interpretation_limit: A stable nonconstant row phase is jointly compatible with pixel_shift_by_row, beam azimuth offsets, beam-origin range effects, and deskew; D4a alone cannot identify factory metadata or change rho_f.

ouster_projection_self_calibration.question: Can the released Cartesian returns identify one Ouster-form projection model whose intrinsics learned from one disjoint frame split predict physical ray lines in the other split?

official_model.encoder_angle: eta_ba = gamma - 2*pi*a/1024 + s_b*(2*pi/1024), with D4a integer shifts s_b fixed and never re-optimized
official_model.nuisance_range_elimination: t = dot(u_ba, X-o_ba); X_hat=o_ba+t*u_ba; official range d=t+sqrt(o_x^2+o_z^2)

ouster_projection_self_calibration.global_fit_sample: all real returns at columns a mod 16 = 0 in the fitting split; final beam angles are re-estimated from all real fitting returns
ouster_projection_self_calibration.robust_loss: Huber loss on orthogonal Cartesian line residual with 0.05 m transition
ouster_projection_self_calibration.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B, numerical gradient, maxiter=500, ftol=1e-12, gtol=1e-9
ouster_projection_self_calibration.fixed_multistarts: D4a common-phase consensus paired with (o_x,o_z) in {(0,0),(0.05,0),(0.05,0.05),(0.05,-0.05)} metres; choose the lowest objective, then lexicographic parameters on an exact tie

global_bounds.gamma: within one nominal column of the D4a circular common-phase consensus

ouster_projection_self_calibration.interpretation_limit: D4b is within-sequence identification. It cannot establish factory metadata identity or cross-sequence transfer; those are reserved for D4c.

ouster_intrinsics_cross_sequence_validat.question: Does the unchanged train/206 D4b main model predict the physical ray lines of the independent normal development sequence train/201?
ouster_intrinsics_cross_sequence_validat.source_model: the even-frame main model in runs/ajae/e11_d4b_calibration.npz
ouster_intrinsics_cross_sequence_validat.exclusion_basis: frozen protocol exclusion for verified exact internal scan and label duplication; all 678 included files are exactly 128x1024x4 float32

ray_grid.empty_ray_direction: same-beam periodic interpolation, explicitly approximate without sensor metadata

normal_controls.template_surface: closed convex hull of one observed labeled instance scan

sensor_model.empty_surface_opportunity: same-beam bracketing-return interpolation when adjacent ranges agree
sensor_model.low_count_backoff: pooled across beam at the same range-incidence cell

render.world_rule: fix every entity, source template, placement, material and seed before rendering any frame

model.name: AJAE four-level time-stratified spatiotemporal point transformer
model.output: one anomaly logit for every input return

training.window_coverage: every legal window exactly once per complete world
training.loss: range-filtered empty-class-safe class-balanced binary cross entropy only

checkpoint_selection.primary: maximum macro mean of per-world AP over the 24 in-generator worlds

difficulty_statistics.Nvis: median accepted visible returns per entity over its visible frames
difficulty_statistics.O: one minus visible inserted returns divided by accepted object returns before nearest-return occlusion
difficulty_statistics.d: median range of accepted visible entity returns
difficulty_statistics.V: number of frames in a five-frame window with at least one accepted entity return

experiments.B1: single-frame AJAE point model with the common counterfactual supervision
experiments.B2: five-frame AJAE with every nonzero-delta edge disabled; evaluate q=0 only
experiments.B3: full center-symmetric five-frame AJAE; evaluate q=0 only
experiments.B4: the exact B3 checkpoint with equal probability fusion over every valid window occurrence
experiments.B5: causal five-frame AJAE [t-4,t]; evaluate current frame only

decision_gates.verdict_rule: a gate verdict requires its real statistics and an explicit predeclared scientific judgment; artifact existence alone is never evidence
